name: Into The Maw of Madness
label: Quest
description: Into The Maw of Madness: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I need you to venture into Hive'Regal and find what became of my dearest Natalia, friend. This will be no easy task for you to do alone. I recommend that you bring some friends along. Before you dive headlong into the maw of madness, make sure that you go back and speak with those dwarves. They might be able to give you some tips on dealing with the silithid that inhabit that hive.
And friend, if she truly is as mad as they say... Do what you must.

clips.title: Completion
paras: C'Thun? WHAT is the meaning of all this? What is C'Thun? How could this fiend have turned my sweet Natalia into the monster that you described?
